tools.name: egf_get_service_info
tools.description: Describes easygroupflights for one market: who it serves, how group fares differ from public tickets, what happens after a quote is requested, and how to reach a person. Submits nothing.

tools.name: egf_prepare_group_quote
tools.description: Checks a group flight enquiry for 10 or more seated travellers and returns the exact brief that would go to a human specialist, with a confirmation_token valid for 15 minutes. Nothing is sent.

tools.name: egf_request_group_quote
tools.description: Sends a prepared group flight enquiry to a human specialist, who replies by email with a written quote, usually within about 2 hours. Takes only the confirmation_token from preparing it; it returns a confirmation, not a price, and books or charges nothing.

tools.name: egf_search_flights
tools.description: Searches live public fares for 1 to 9 travellers and returns options with per-person prices, carriers and stops, cheapest first, each with an offer_id valid for 30 minutes. Results come in pages: pass next_cursor back as cursor, with the same route and dates, for more.

tools.name: egf_get_offer
tools.description: Returns one fare from a recent flight search, by its offer_id: the per-person price, the flights, a booking link and the time until which the offer_id is valid. Works for 30 minutes after the search.

tools.name: egf_prepare_flight_offer
tools.description: Checks an email that would send one fare from a flight search to the traveller as a formal offer, and returns who it goes to and what it offers, with a confirmation_token valid for 15 minutes. Nothing is sent.

tools.name: egf_send_flight_offer
tools.description: Emails a prepared flight offer to the traveller as a formal offer they can accept. Takes only the confirmation_token from preparing it, and sends a real email.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: egf_get_service_info, egf_prepare_flight_offer · Public sink: egf_request_group_quote, egf_prepare_flight_offer, egf_send_flight_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: egf_get_service_info, egf_prepare_flight_offer · Public sink: egf_request_group_quote, egf_prepare_flight_offer, egf_send_flight_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
